mentions.name: Fairvisor
mentions.description: API governance and usage control tool that acts as a guardrail in front of an API. It offers per-tenant and per-route rate limits, request budgets with soft/hard caps, and anomaly alerts for sudden spikes. The edge component is open source (OpenResty/Nginx + Lua), while the SaaS part provides policy management and audit.
mentions.problem: One buggy integration, scraper, or infinite retry loop can suddenly explode API costs or overload infrastructure before anyone notices.
mentions.audience: Validating whether teams would use something like this instead of building internal scripts.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Fairvisor — a tool for API governance and usage control.
